plotTwists: {user} winds up the fish... and it turns out to be a rubber fish toy. {target} is somehow even more offended.
{target} catches the fish mid-air and immediately claims it as their new pet.
The fish slap somehow triggers a chain reaction of seafood-based chaos across the whole server.
A chicken wanders between them and steals the fish mid-swing, entirely unbothered. 🐔
{user} swings the fish, but it slips out of their hand and flops away entirely on its own.

npcInteractions.line: Take that outside. And take the smell with you.
Reminds me of my days at the fish market. Good form, though.
Even my ancient roots found that mildly amusing, and a little pungent.
The King has been notified and demands to know where the fish came from.
I sell fresher fish, if you're interested. Yours has seen better days.
The winds carried that fish further than expected, and the smell too.
